title: Multi-node daemon composition
description: Objective: compose graph admission, readiness, fairness, expansion, integration, and supersession into authenticated daemon commands and projections. Deliverable: daemon graph application services. NOT in scope: UI rendering or relaxing Foundation effect safety. Hard dependencies: every preceding Graph Beta kernel. Owned paths: apps/daemon/src/graph/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: Every graph command produces one durable terminal decision with exact replay.
Scheduler decisions cannot bypass policy, budget, lease, input, integration, or epoch checks.
Concurrent expansion/supersession/cancel schedules preserve one active revision and complete timelines.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
